name: Typewriter line
what: A line of small text typed out letter by letter on a dark ground, centred and growing from the middle, with a blinking dash cursor that waits at the start, stays solid while it types and keeps blinking afterwards.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f30 (00:00:00:00-00:00:01:00) only the cursor dash at the centre, blinking (4 frames on, about 6 off, a 9.7-frame beat); f31-f54 (00:00:01:01-00:00:01:24) 14 letters are typed at an uneven human pace (one every 1.8 frames), the centred line growing from the middle with the cursor solid; f54-f299 (00:00:01:24-00:00:09:29) the cursor blinks 5 frames on, 5 off while the text stays
